up: Find all distinct compounds mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3639333. Return each compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES. Filter using docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639333' and join compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639333'
